mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tender(tender_id, drug_name, manufacturer, packaging_requirements, total_quantity, deadline, deposit, status, create_time) VALUES(#{tenderId}, #{drugName}, #{manufacturer}, #{packagingRequirements}, #{totalQuantity}, #{deadline}, #{deposit}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tender ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT * FROM tender WHERE 1=1
AND drug_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{drugName}, '%')
AND tender_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tenderId}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
